No change to keyPair generation, attestation signer, advertised-model filtering, weight hash maps, or encryption paths. Integration questions: ProviderLoop+SelectedModelRecovery's no-eviction reload must re-use ensureModelLoaded's advertised-set guard, failedSelfTestHashes/retiringModels tombstones, and weight-hash capture so recovery cannot resurrect a failed-self-test build (T-012/T-027) or bypass the addon hold (TB-012/T-059) or drain/update admission gates (A-018); that source was not provided. The daemon state file is an operator-local artifact (TB-003) and its new fields grant no trust. No regression identified in the supplied units.
